next.reason: 1985: 'unsuccessfully executed as the result of a condition that is specified by the implementor. ... If more than one value applies, the implementor determines'; 2023: 'An implementor-defined condition exists. This condition shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value.'. Both define the implementor-defined 9x status. 2023 forbids it duplicating other status conditions, and no candidate keeps the implementor's choice when several values apply.
